title: docs(adr): ADR-0066 ⑧'s `when` note names the record-scoped field projection as a third, row-aware reader (#26594, ruling B)
body:
Fixes #27075
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md` ⑧ 下新增一条 2026-10-28 的注记(全文 +2 行,其一为空行),点名「记录级字段投影」`GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id/field-access` 是字段权限 `when` 的第三个读者、且是按存储行判定的那一个;ADR 其余每一行一字未动。
- 为什么改:PR #27063(card #26594,裁决记录 6457467702 字母 B)已把这个按行判定的读者落在 main 上,但 ADR 的 2026-10-26 注记只点名了写门与不看行的读者;读 ADR 的人会以为没有任何读者看得到行。现在三类读者在 ADR 里都有名字。
- 风险与回滚:零运行时影响(纯 ADR 文本,`docs/adr/**` 不发布,打 `skip-changeset`);回滚即 revert 本 PR 的单个 commit。
- 先看:只有一个文件、一个 hunk —— `docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md` L135–L136(新注记);核对其三句话与 `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-field-readers.ts` L233–L248、`packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts` L364–L366 一致。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main...HEAD --numstat`,预期恰好一行 `2 0 docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`。
- 需要你做的:Tier H(`docs/adr/**` 受管面)—— 一次 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 账号的 APPROVED review;批准后由席位落地,不需要你点合并。

## What changes

One dated note under ⑧ of ADR-0066, placed directly after the 2026-10-26 note (ruling of record 6408558941) and before ⑨, in the file's own form: a blank line, the indented blockquote, a bold dated lead-in, one paragraph on one line (1116 characters against the existing note's 1457). Nothing else in the ADR moves — the 2026-10-26 note, the header and `**Status**:` line, every other item, and `docs/adr/README.md` (generated by `scripts/adr-index.mjs` from `**Status**:` lines only; `check:adr-index` reports it current) are byte-identical to `origin/main`.

The note, verbatim:

> **Note (2026-10-28) — a third reader of `when` holds the row: the record-scoped field projection (#26594, ruling of record 6457467702, letter B).** `GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id/field-access` (`SecurityPlugin.getRecordFieldAccess`, the answer a record's edit form reads) judges each field permission's `when` against the **stored** row with the write gate's own function, `computeForbiddenFieldWrites`, asked as an update by id of that row naming every field over the same sets, posture and delegator intersection the gate takes — so its `editable` list is the gate's field-level verdict for that row, a conditioned lock disables a field only on the rows its condition names, and no second evaluator of `when` exists for it to drift from. The row-blind readers (`/auth/me/permissions`, the object-level field projections, `os explain`) are unchanged and still apply a conditioned entry as its lock, and `readable` stays row-blind. The record is read first exactly as `GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id` reads it, so an absent or unreadable row answers that read's refusal, and no reading is wider than the gate's.

Where each clause was read from on `origin/main` (`24351cfe`, the merge base):

- (a) The record-scoped projection judges `when` on the STORED row with the write gate's own function. Route: `GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id/field-access` as `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts` L364 spells it, registered at `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts` L356 as `${dataPath}/:object/:id/field-access`. Judge: `SecurityPlugin.getRecordFieldAccess` (`security-plugin.ts` L3013) reads the row as the caller reads it and asks `resolveProjectionFieldMask`'s `readRowForbiddenWrites` (`security-plugin-field-readers.ts` L241), which calls `computeForbiddenFieldWrites` — the exported symbol `security-plugin.ts` L57 imports from `security-plugin-object-inputs.ts` — with `operation: 'update'` and the stored row as `preImage`, naming every field. The record form reads it: `client.data.fieldAccess` (ledger L364; `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx` L60–67). "Field-level verdict" is deliberate: the object grant and row-level walls are judged elsewhere, as the schema text and the PR #27063 contract review (record 6460514485) state.
- (b) The row-blind readers are unchanged and still apply a conditioned entry as its lock: the PR #27063 contract review ("Unchanged without the record — holds": `/auth/me/permissions`, `getWritableFields`, `getReadableFields`, `getMetadataReadableFields`, `getQueryableFields`, `os explain` untouched) and `field-level-security.mdx` L55–59. `readable` stays row-blind: `permission.zod.ts` L923 and the `getRecordFieldAccess` docblock.
- (c) No reading is wider than the gate's: the route reads the record through `getData` first with the same gates and mapped refusals as `GET /data/:object/:id`, so an absent or unreadable row answers that read's refusal (`data-action-routes.ts` L349–352; ledger note L366).
- (d) Cites #26594 and the ruling of record 6457467702, letter B (read in full this act: "the server judges each field permission's `when` against the stored row exactly as the write gate does … `/auth/me/permissions` and the other row-less readers keep reporting a conditioned entry as its lock").

Premise verified before writing: `git log --oneline -1 --grep='#27063' origin/main` → `f9f27a06 feat(spec,plugin-security,rest,client): a record-scoped field projection judges a \`when\` lock on the stored row (#27063)` — merged and on `origin/main`; its file list carried no `docs/adr/**`, and L134 of the ADR still named only the write gate and the row-blind readers.

## Acceptance notes

- Dispatch-order hypotheses, measured — all five held, one with a correction: (1) `docs/adr/README.md` is generated from `**Status**:` lines only, so an in-place note owes it nothing; left untouched and reported current. (2) The derived list is the ADR/docs prose families plus the whole-tree families, nothing from the test tiers; but `check:pm-governed-prose`, the family the order named, does not derive for this path (it reads `AGENTS.md`'s governed-surface paragraph), and no markdown-lint or link-check family exists beyond `check:adr-links`. The ADR siblings that derived: `check:adr-links`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-index`, `check:adr-symbol-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`. (3) The ledger's spelling of the route is the one cited. (4) `computeForbiddenFieldWrites` is the exported symbol; the plugin's private method of the same name wraps it. (5) `check:pm-skill-id-lint` scans `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch`, `skills/`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` and `AGENTS.md` only.
- The 2026-10-26 note's phrase "every row-blind reader (`/auth/me/permissions`, the field projections, `os explain`)" now reads beside the new note and is left verbatim by the card's scope (⑧ only, one dated note). Not a finding.
- Spelling variance, not a contract violation: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/security.mdx` L264 spells the route `GET /data/{object}/{id}/field-access`, `field-level-security.mdx` L61 spells `GET /api/v1/data/{object}/{id}/field-access`, and the ledger spells `:object/:id`. The ADR cites the ledger's. Noted, not filed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` are not built in a fresh worktree. Built both under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 89s · waited 0s`) and re-ran: exit 0. A local-environment fact, not a finding; nothing was measured by the first run.
- Out-of-scope findings in classes a/b/c: none.
- Attribution: the commit carries the model-free trailer pair AGENTS.md prescribes; the harness attribution reminder's model-named trailer form and its PR-footer form were not used, by that reminder's own precedence sentence.
